'''Nerfsteak sandwich''' was a type of [[Sandwich/Legends|sandwich]] which consisted of a [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerf steak]] and sizzling hot [[Red Nebula onion]]s on a [[Pseudograin bread|pseudogrian roll]]. It was served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] for 8.70 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was, according to [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], a personal favorite of [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]] [[Mayor/Legends|mayor]], [[Acros-Krik]].
